CITY COUNCIL MEETING FOR DECEMBER 15, 2022, AT 5:00 P.M. WILL BE
HELD BY VIDEOCONFERENCE/TELECONFERENCE.
City
Council Meeting Policy:
www.cityofpasadena.net/city-clerk/wp-content/uploads/sites/21/City-Council-Meeting-Policy.pdf
In order to facilitate public participation at meetings held solely by
electronic means, the City will accept public comment in the following manner:
1. During the meeting, members of
the public may provide live public comment by submitting a speaker card prior to
the start of public comment on that item, at the following webpage:
www.cityofpasadena.net/city-clerk/public-comment
If a public comment speaker wishes to speak on more than one agenda item, please
indicate so on the online form (multiple item speakers will be handled according
to the process posted on the agenda and as specified in the City Council meeting
policy). Public comments are limited to 3 minutes each, and the Mayor and City
Council may limit this time if reasonable under the circumstances.
2. Speaker Card Help Line : If
a public comment speaker needs assistance in completing a speaker card, please
call the City Clerk’s Office at: (626) 744-4124. Help line will open
30 minutes prior to the posted
start time of the meeting.
After submitting a public speaker card, join the virtual meeting after the
published start time with a computer, other electronic device, or by telephone.
The same name or telephone number on the Speaker Card should be used for the
virtual meeting in order to locate and unmute the speaker.
Your phone call to the City Council
meeting will be recorded as part of the City Council meeting. By
staying on the line and making public comment during the City Council meeting,
you are agreeing to have your phone call recorded.
Computer or electronic devices, join the meeting at:
https://us02web.zoom.us/j/161482446
Telephone only dial-in: 1-669-900-6833, Meeting
ID: 161 482 446
3. Members of the public may
submit correspondence of any length prior to the start of the meeting, at the
following email address:
correspondence@cityofpasadena.net
Correspondence will be forwarded to the City Council
prior to the start of the meeting, posted online, and made part of the
legislative record for the item.
LIVESTREAM
WITH CAPTIONING IS AVAILABLE AT
WWW.PASADENAMEDIA.ORG ,
AND ALSO AT
WWW.CITYOFPASADENA.NET/COMMISSIONS/AGENDAS ,
TO HEAR A LIVE SPANISH TRANSLATION OF THE MEETING (LISTEN ONLY), PLEASE DIAL-IN
10 MINUTES PRIOR TO THE MEETING (4:50 P.M.):
TOLL-FREE DIAL-IN: (888) 585-9008
PARTICIPANT PASSCODE: 739-142-091, THEN #
IF
YOU NEED A REASONABLE MODIFICATION OR ACCOMMODATION PURSUANT TO THE AMERICANS
WITH DISABILITIES ACT
BECAUSE YOU ARE UNABLE TO PARTICIPATE ELECTRONICALLY AS SET FORTH
ABOVE, CONTACT THE CITY CLERK’S OFFICE
AS SOON AS POSSIBLE AT (626) 744-4124 OR
CITYCLERK@CITYOFPASADENA.NET .
_______________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________
LA REUNIÓN ESPECIAL DEL CONSEJO MUNICIPAL DEL 15 DE DICIEMBRE DE 2022 A LAS 5:00
P.M. SE REALIZARÁ POR VIDEOCONFERENCIA/TELECONFERENCIA.
City
Council Meeting Policy:
www.cityofpasadena.net/city-clerk/wp-content/uploads/sites/21/City-Council-Meeting-Policy.pdf
Para facilitar la participación del público en reuniones realizadas únicamente
por medios electrónicos, la Ciudad aceptará comentarios del público de la
siguiente manera:
1. Durante la reunión, los miembros del
público pueden hacer comentarios públicos en vivo presentando una tarjeta de
oratoria antes del inicio del comentario sobre el artículo que se está tratando
en el siguiente sitio web:
www.cityofpasadena.net/city-clerk/public-comment
Si un orador de comentario público desea hablar sobre más de un artículo del
orden del día, le solicitamos que lo indique en el formulario en línea (los
oradores sobre artículos múltiples se manejarán según el proceso publicado en la
agenda y lo especificado en la política sobre las reuniones el Consejo
Municipal). Los comentarios públicos se limitan a 3 minutos cada uno y el
Alcalde y el Consejo Municipal pueden limitar este tiempo si lo consideran
razonable para las circunstancias.
2. Línea
de ayuda de la tarjeta de oratoria pública :
Si un orador de comentario público necesita asistencia para completar su
tarjeta, puede llamar
a la Oficina del
Secretario de la Ciudad al
(626) 744-4124. La línea de ayuda abrirá 30
minutos antes del inicio de la reunión.
Después de presentar una tarjeta de oratoria pública, únase a la reunión virtual
a la
h ora
de inicio publicada con una computadora, otro dispositivo electrónico o por
teléfono. Debe usar el
mismo nombre o número de teléfono de la tarjeta de orator ia
para la reunión virtual de modo que se pueda ubicar y habilitar el audio para el
orador.
Su llamada telefónica a la reunión del Concejo
Municipal se grabará como parte de la
reunión del Concejo Municipal. Al permanecer en la línea y hacer
comentarios públicos durante la
reunión del Concejo Municipal, está aceptando que se grabe su llamada
telefónica.
Computadoras y dispositivos electrónicos pueden sumarse a la reunión en:
https://us02web.zoom.us/j/161482446
Número para ingresar a la reunión por teléfono: 1-669-900-6833, ID de la
reunión: 161 482 446
3. Los miembros del público
pueden enviar correspondencia de cualquier longitud antes del inicio de
la reunión a la siguiente dirección de correo electrónico:
correspondence@cityofpasadena.net
La
correspondencia se enviará al Consejo Municipal antes del inicio de la reunión,
se publicará en línea, y se incorporará al registro legislativo sobre el
artículo.
TRANSMISIÓN
EN VIVO CON SUBTÍTULOS EN
WWW.PASADENAMEDIA.ORG ,
Y TAMBIÉN EN
WWW.CITYOFPASADENA.NET/COMMISSIONS/AGENDAS ,

NÚMERO DE ACCESO GRATUITO: (888) 585-9008
CÓDIGO DE PARTICIPANTE: 739-142-091, LUEGO #
SI NECESITA UNA ADAPTACIÓN O MODIFICACIÓN RAZONABLE EN VIRTUD DE LA LEY DE

PORQUE NO PUEDE PARTICIPAR EN FORMA ELECTRÓNICA SEGÚN LO DESCRITO ANTERIORMENTE,
COMUNÍQUESE CON LA OFICINA DE LA SECRETARÍA MUNICIPAL
LO ANTES POSIBLE POR EL (626) 744-4124 O
CITYCLERK@CITYOFPASADENA.NET .

CITY OF PASADENA
  City Council Minutes
  December 15, 2022 - 5:00 P.M.

I  City Hall Council Chamber

  SPECIAL MEETING
  The special meeting was convened and held virtually by videoconference/teleconference.

  OPENING:  Mayor Gordo called the special meeting to order at 5:04 p.m. The
  pledge of allegiance was led by Councilmember Lyon.

  ROLL CALL:  Mayor Victor M. Gordo
  Councilmembers:  Vice Mayor Felica Williams
  Councilmember Tyron Hampton
  Councilmember Jason Lyon
  Councilmember Steve Madison
  Councilmember Gene Masuda
  Councilmember Jessica Rivas

  Staff:  City Manager Miguel Marquez
  City Attorney/City Prosecutor Michele Beal Bagneris
  City Clerk Mark Jomsky

  Mayor Gordo made introductory comments and provided an
  overview of the City Council District 3 interview and appointment
  selection process.

I  Mayor Gordo spoke on the passing of Mr. Raymond (Ray) Rivera,
  a long-time Pasadena resident, providing a summary of Mr.
  Rivera's personal and professional history, and requested that the
  City Council adjourn in his memory.

  PUBLIC COMMENT  The following individuals provided comments on the appointment
  REGARDING ITEMS ON  process and/or advocating for a City Charter amendment to allow
  THIS SPECIAL MEETING  for a special election in lieu of an appointment process:
  AGENDA
  Yadi, Pasadena resident
  Jill Shook, Pasadena resident
  Emanuel Najera, Pasadena resident

  The following individuals advocated for the City Council to appoint
  Brandon Lamar as Pasadena Council District 3 Councilmember:

  Michael Williams, Pasadena resident
  Dawn Burkhardt, Pasadena resident
  Allison Henry, Pasadena resident
  Evie, Pasadena resident
  Adriana Bautista, Pasadena resident

I  Kaveh Naeeni, Pasadena resident
  Lisbeth Vega, Pasadena resident
  Ed Washatka, Pasadena resident

  Council Minutes  12/15/2022
   Sarah Cruz, Pasadena resident

  The following individuals advocated for the City Council to appoint

I  Justin Jones as Pasadena Council District 3 Councilmember:

  Deborah Douglass, Burbank resident - Jones
  Natalya Romo Jones, Pasadena resident
  Kevin Jackson, Lancaster resident
  Francis Sevillano, Atwater resident
  Sirlina Cook, Los Angeles resident
  Elaine Stokes, Lancaster resident
  Karl Percell, Glendale resident
  Leticia Martinez, Pasadena resident

  Mark Jomsky, City Clerk, reported that the City Clerk's Office
  received one hundred forty-three letters advocating for the
  appointment of Justin Jones, noting that thirty-four letters are from
  residents in District 3, twenty-two letters are from residents' in other
  districts, forty-six letters  from individuals residing outside
  Pasadena, and forty-one letters with no address listed; and reported
  that the City Clerk's Office received ninety-nine letters advocating
  for the appointment of Brandon Lamar, noting that fifty-six letters
  are from residents in District 3, five letters from residents in other
  districts, two letters from individuals residing outside Pasadena, and
  twenty-eight letters with no address listed; and two letters providing

I  comments related to the appointment process; with all
  correspondence distributed to the City Council, posted on-line, and
  made part of the public record.

  APPLICANT PRESENTATIONS, INTERVIEWS, AND CITY
  COUNCIL SELECTION OF AN APPOINTEE TO FILL A
  VACANCY ON THE CITY COUNCIL, REPRESENTING DISTRICT
  3, PURSUANT TO CITY CHARTER SECTION 404

  City Clerk Jomsky reported that applicants will be interviewed in the
  following order (as was determined by random drawing): Brandon
  Lamar then Justin Jones.

  Brandon Lamar, District 3 applicant provided an overview of his
  personal and professional experiences and highlighted the
  divisiveness that the appointment process has caused in the
  community.  He stated the following for the record: "I am
  withdrawing my name from this application process and I will see
  you in 2024."

  Mayor Gordo, Vice Mayor Williams, and Councilmembers Masuda,

I  Madison, Rivas and Lyon expressed their thanks, appreciation, and
  gratitude to Mr. Lamar for his leadership in the community and
  interest in serving in this important role to represent District 3, and
  encouraged him to continue his work.

  Council Minutes  2  12/15/2022
   Justin Jones, District 3 applicant, provided a brief statement and
  expressed his appreciation and gratitude for the opportunity to
  continue to serve District 3.

I  It was moved by Vice Mayor Williams, seconded by Councilmember
  Masuda, to nominate Justin Jones to serve as the appointed City
  Councilmember representing District 3:

  AYES:  Councilmembers Hampton, Lyon, Madison, Masuda,
  Rivas, Vice Mayor Williams, Mayor Gordo
  NOES:  None
  ABSENT: None
  ABSTAIN: None

  Mayor Gordo congratulated Justin Jones as the appointed
  Pasadena City Councilmember for District 3.

  OATH OF OFFICE ADMINISTERED TO NEWLY APPOINTED
  DISTRICT 3 COUNCILMEMBER BY CITY CLERK

  City Clerk Jomsky administered the oath of office to Justin Jones
  as Pasadena City Councilmember representing District 3.

  ADJOURNMENT  On order of the Mayor, the special meeting of the City Council
  adjourned at 6:14 p.m., in memory of Ray Rivera and in

I  remembrance of the Honorable District 3 Councilmember, John J.
  Kenney

  Victor M. Gordo, Mayor
  City of Pasadena
  ATTEST:

  City#

I
  Council Minutes  3  12/15/2022
